budget_policy.execution_sim_seconds: retain selected runtime task limit; must be numeric and frozen in run manifest
budget_policy.reset_policy: one original generated reset per full attempt; new attempt gets new run_id
budget_policy.token_observation_control_budgets: freeze in runnable task manifest; no agent benchmark run until all required fields are numeric
budget_policy.mutation_policy: Any budget or parameter revision creates a new manifest before next attempt; preserve earlier attempt

shared_acceptance.start: original generator sample; no checkpoint stitching
shared_acceptance.mapping_rule: Every executed low-level segment links its high-level parent, exact action/state frame interval, measured entry/exit and pass/fail evidence; planned but unexecuted segments remain unexecuted.
shared_acceptance.delivery: Correct target whole envelope in D, independent support, released, stable for 3 s; task-specific frozen original H1 scoring preserved.

q_exit.threshold_status: draft until per-body calibration and task-manifest freeze

forbidden_inferences: successful run => human review or formal admission
